patthana8.13:1.1: viññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na konaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭaṭicca na kenaciviññeyyo ca na na kenaci viññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā,
patthana8.13:2.1: na na kenaciviññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na na kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana8.13:3.1: kenaci viññeyyaṃ ca na kenaci viññeyyaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na kenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi
